title: ILDA: Laser show history
why: The best index to the history, with links to primary accounts of Krebs, The Who's lasers and the early companies.

title: W. Patrick McCray: Lasers, Pot Smoke, and the 'Visual Art of the Future'
why: A historian of technology on Laserium, Garmire and Dryer, with the patent and the hardware.

title: Lowell Cross: Remembering David Tudor
why: First-person account of the 1969 Mills College show and Expo '70, with model numbers and dates.

title: IMERSA: Light Years, a preview of Ivan Dryer's book on Laserium
why: Dryer's own chronology, venue by venue and show by show.

title: Glenn Thomas: The Laserium Laserist
why: A former laserist's memoir of what the job was each night, console and breakdowns included.

title: William Bridges: Ion Lasers - The Early Years
why: The inventor's account of the argon and krypton lasers that made colored shows possible.

title: LaserFX: A Brief History of Laser Light Shows
why: A 1990s trade history, strong on the art precursors and the first automated shows.

title: Fortune: The Last Laser Show
why: A 2002 business-press account of Laserium's rise and its final weeks at Griffith.
